outcome: Risk factors for low birth weight
cohort: 1012 mothers of low birth weight infants in Ad-Diwaniyah city, Iraq
finding: The rate of low birth weight was 20.2%, and significant risk factors included multiple pregnancies, maternal age 21-35 years, lack of prenatal care, Cesarean section delivery, maternal illiteracy, rural residence, and presence of maternal diseases.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was a significant risk factor for low birth weight.
